gate6_basis_rule.rule: Gate 6 is computed on the DOCUMENTED rent roll: the stated in-place rent for each occupied unit (lease, rent ledger, MLS 'actual rent' or seller text), and the block-comp median only for a vacant unit. The stabilized (all-comp) figure is reported alongside for the negotiation. A row passes Gate 6 only when the documented roll clears 8 percent cash-on-cash at 6.75 (the board's legacy constant) AND year-one cash-on-cash at 7.40 is not negative. In-place rents below 60 percent of the modeled rent are flagged on the row.

nc_adu_statute_2026.sl_2026_59_s44: G.S. 160D-917: a local government 'shall allow the development of at least one accessory dwelling unit which conforms to the North Carolina Residential Code ... for each single-family detached dwelling in areas zoned for residential use that allow for development of single-family detached dwellings'; shall not prohibit separate-household long-term rental of the primary and the ADU, require conditional zoning, set parking requirements, prohibit connection to the primary's utilities (capacity permitting), charge fees above a single-family permit, or set a size cap under 800 or over 1,000 sf; may require a 10-ft (or smaller district) setback, side-or-rear placement and that the ADU be smaller than the primary; exempts private covenants, historic districts, National Historic Landmarks and units without water and sewer; applies to non-coastal cities of 50,000+

gate3_two_family_rule._note: Najum's answer of 9/25/2026 to the framework question raised by advisory 51 / file 44 (306 Auburndale).
gate3_two_family_rule.rule: Gate 3 (true duplex) requires a TWO-FAMILY classification of record or by written zoning determination: two dwelling units lawfully permitted or lawfully nonconforming as a two-family use. A legal single-family house plus one accessory dwelling unit (attached or detached, under a local ADU section or G.S. 160D-917) does NOT satisfy Gate 3.
gate3_two_family_rule.consequences: Z-CURABLE-ADU is not a pass path; carry it only as context. A converted house in a single-family district passes Gate 3 only on a written lawful-nonconforming-duplex determination (with the rebuild right stated, per lender_property_screen.fannie_rebuild_rule) or after a rezoning to a district where duplexes are permitted. Rows whose only two-unit status is an ADU route go OUT unless a two-family path exists.

advisory_56_rules_adopted._note: Adopted 9/26/26 (round 18, 307 N Church St Clayton, new board row w6). Advisory 56's ten unknown unknowns and six pipeline suggestions (photo watermark dating, zoning-history check, stream/buffer/slope intersects, property-based lien search with OCR, assessment-based NC tax, FSBO flag) are accepted; the entries below are what the verification added or amended.
advisory_56_rules_adopted.rod_name_index_for_individuals: run the Register of Deeds both-names index for an individual seller as well as the legal-remarks search: it is a title check, not profiling, and it surfaces instruments the legal index misses - the Church owner's five instruments include two 2026 EASEMENTS to the Town of Clayton (a drainage project on the lot) that no listing, card or layer showed; record counts, types and book/pages, never a dossier
advisory_56_rules_adopted.easement_to_municipality_rule: a recent easement to a town or county is a project signal: read the image for the purpose (drainage / sewer / greenway), the area, the exclusive-use terms (no structures, tree cutting, written approval for grade work), the surveyor's job title (WithersRavenel 'N Church St and E Front St Drainage') and the temporary construction easement's termination; then ask the town's engineer what is being built and when
advisory_56_rules_adopted.plat_boilerplate_flood_note: a surveyor's exhibit note that 'portions of the property are in Zone AE' must be checked against the NFHL polygon before it enters a row: the Church plat carried the note and the whole parcel is Zone X (nearest SFHA about 400 m)
advisory_56_rules_adopted.nfhl_polygon_query: query FEMA NFHL layer 28 (and floodway layer 20) with the PARCEL POLYGON, not a point; report the zone(s), the grid share inside each and the distance from the footprint to the nearest SFHA edge
advisory_56_rules_adopted.creek_boundary_geometry: when a deed runs 'with the meanders of' a branch, pull the town or county parcel polygon by PIN (the OneMap layer failed for Johnston), identify the footprint inside it, and measure footprint-to-stream (Church: 28 ft, inside the 50-ft Neuse buffer) and footprint-to-line distances; the county's 'stream 4 m from the centroid' read becomes a buffer finding
advisory_56_rules_adopted.mls_syndication_history: when Zillow shows a for-sale-by-owner page with no history, the prior MLS listing survives on raleighrealty.com (list date, price, remarks, agent, photo count) and on Redfin's third address page (/home/<id>: 'Listed' and 'Listing Removed' dates); realtor.com and Redfin 'Off Market' confirm the MLS listing is not live; Church: 5/18/2026 at 340,000, removed 6/2/2026
advisory_56_rules_adopted.seller_rental_listing_check: search Zillow rentals for the subject's units during a sale: a seller marketing the vacant unit (Church: unit A at 1,200 on 9/21/2026, 12-month term) fixes the documented roll, signals a holder rather than a cutter, and stops any abandonment clock
advisory_56_rules_adopted.own_ask_as_vacant_unit_rent: under gate6_basis_rule the vacant unit's figure is the block-comp median; when the seller's own current rental ask for that unit exists, carry it as the documented figure and the block-comp median as a second line (Church: 1,200 own ask vs 1,350 block median)
advisory_56_rules_adopted.county_sales_export_ratios: Johnston's TaxJO Sales.aspx + ExportSalesReport.aspx returns every sale in a neighbourhood or township with the CURRENT sales ratio and appraised values: use the qualified median as the reappraisal-stress ratio (00380: 0.916) and filter Use/Mod 62 for the county-confirmed duplex cohort; the on-page grid caps at 50 rows, the export does not
advisory_56_rules_adopted.udo_edition_diff: keep the original, the first amended and the current UDO editions and diff the use table AND the district purpose statements: Clayton's 4/15/2024 edition removed duplexes from the RHD statement but not from RMD's, which is how a stale 'permits duplex dwellings' sentence survives next to a prohibiting table
advisory_56_rules_adopted.casualty_clause_vs_fannie: a UDO clause that bars restoring a nonconforming use after a casualty threshold (Clayton 5.6.7: 51 percent of assessed value, single-family exempted) makes the Fannie B4-1.3-04 rebuild-right letter impossible for a nonconforming duplex: treat conventional financing as unavailable and price the 8.00 leg (DSCR / portfolio) before any offer
advisory_56_rules_adopted.determination_fee: a formal zoning determination has a price (Clayton 500, resubmittal 250) and a Type I procedure with appeal rights; advisory opinions are non-binding - budget the letter and ask for the formal one
advisory_56_rules_adopted.utility_stack_per_unit: price the tenant's monthly utility stack from the town's fee schedule (base charges plus commodity at 700 kWh / 4,000 gal) and carry it as a rent-discount case where a municipal electric utility and wholesale water/sewer pass-throughs apply (Clayton about 305 a unit); the ZIP averages are set by newer, lower-load stock

Advisory 54's six pipeline suggestions (parcel-first unit check, remarks parser, tracked-URL fallback, photo provenance hashing, suppression list, weekly PMMS re-stamp) are accepted as rules; the entries below are what the verification added or amended.
advisory_54_rules_adopted.attached_house_rule: single-family attached / attached house / fee-simple townhouse product FAILS Gate 3 whatever the remarks say: the tests are (a) unit letters or halves on SEPARATE parcels or address points (Durham UNIT A / UNIT B on different PARCEL_IDs), (b) a county class of townhouse or 1-family (Durham RES/TWNH W/ LAND; CAMA 'UNITS 1', style 'TWN-RW ... 1CW'), (c) a building permit per half with DWELLING_UNITS 1, (d) a plat titled attached house / recombination-attached house, (e) an MLS sub type Townhouse or Single Family Attached, (f) remarks 'lives like a single family home', 'attached at the garage', 'one party wall', 'classified as single-family attached'; a 4-bed 2.5-bath count is one dwelling, never two 2BR units; Redfin's multifamily filter and the word 'Duplex' in remarks are not evidence
advisory_54_rules_adopted.durham_udo_duplex: Durham's current UDO (udo.durhamnc.gov, amended 6/2026) permits the Duplex housing type in RS-20, RS-10, RS-8 and RS-M (6.3.2) with the 7.1.6 dimensions (RS-8: 8,000 sf, 60 ft) and NO Suburban-tier bar: advisory 54's 'not permitted in the Suburban tier' assumption is WITHDRAWN; pre-2019 the housing type was Urban-tier only (EHC Attachment H); durham.municipal.codes is a dead host - read the City's MadCap pages
advisory_54_rules_adopted.durham_permit_layer_keying: Durham Inspections layer 12 keys a pair's permits to ONE lot's PIN15/PID (639 B's permits sit on 639 A's identifiers): query by buffer, not by the subject's REID; layer 11 (COs) stopped at 6/27/2025 - a blank CO_SIGNOFF_DATE on a 2026 permit is unverified, not absent; ask for the CO
advisory_54_rules_adopted.rod_name_index_for_builders: for a builder-seller run the Register of Deeds both-names index under the entity (Durham Eagle Self-Service: non-human, entity in the first-name field) with a date floor, then read the facets: SUBSTITUTE TRUSTEE and deeds TO lenders are the distress tells; check each construction deed of trust for a satisfaction or partial release on the SOLD halves (Conover: none of record on 639 A five months after closing) and for blanket re-leverage across the unsold halves (Conover: a four-tract deed of trust 5/26/2026); a lender's successor-trustee appointment on a sister building (637 Conover, 8/27/2026) six days before a re-list is a motivation signal
advisory_54_rules_adopted.redfin_rekeying_rule: when a new-construction listing is filed under a parent address, Redfin keys it to the PARENT parcel record until the MLS record is edited with a unit letter, then creates unit records (639: parent 185159569 -> Unit A 197654778 / Unit B 197654779 on 9/14/2026); a tracked parent URL that flips to the land sale is a RE-KEYING, not an off-market event: resolve the unit records with the stingray location-autocomplete (in the browser) before writing OFF MARKET
